clos.loDetails: Understand the properties and basic nature of language and some linguistic issues, key concepts in various linguistic aspects, e.g., phonetics, morphology, grammar, semantics, pragmatics, etc
Apply the learned knowledge to specialize in other different subjects, such as phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics…
Analyze and distinguish the linguistic aspects.

Have good behavior to apprehend the knowledge which is applied effectively in the future job; have a great awareness and true love for the future job; have a good connection among related subjects to cooperate and work well with others.
